question: Tamilisai Soundararajan was the Lieutenant Governor of which of the following union territories before resigning to contest the Lok Sabha elections in 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1) Puducherry**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Tamilisai Soundararajan** served as the **Lieutenant Governor of Puducherry** from February 2021 to 2024.
 
• She assumed the additional charge of Puducherry while also serving as the **Governor of Telangana**.
 
• Her tenure as Lieutenant Governor included efforts to strengthen the administrative framework and promote socio-economic development in Puducherry.
